messages.subject: Dynamic UI with textboxes
parts:
Not sure if this is a bug or not but the condition for conditionalPanel for use with text boxes does not follow the format on the tutorial page.
http://rstudio.github.io/shiny/tutorial/#dynamic-ui

Following the tutorial I would expect the condition below (in bold) to have been "input.size >= 10" but that does not work. Instead, what is below works fine. Just wanted to share in case someone else runs into this problem as it took me a while to figure out what was wrong.

  sidebarPanel(
    sliderInput("pr", 
                "Probability of a Success", 
                min = .0,
                max = 1.0, 
                value = .50,
                step=.01),
    numericInput("size",
                "N, the number of trials",
                min=2,
                max=1000,
                value=4),
    conditionalPanel(
    condition="size.value >= 10",
   checkboxInput(inputId = "scale2",
                 label = strong("Show full scale of possible values (Successes)"),
                 value = FALSE)
    )
  )
